title: mentha limosa
intro: Mentha limosa, commonly known as Wild Ginger Mint, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and relieving headaches and nausea. The therapeutic actions of Mentha limosa are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and act as a natural diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthol, limonene, and other volatile oils that contribute to its medicinal properties.
